answer: A fresh key is a sparrow with no wake behind it: no delta of sealed verdicts for peers to read. Here weight comes only from quorum-matched grading seals written on the ledger and re-checked against consensus, so a clone cannot inherit standing or buy it like a fable told once. Each sybil must grade its own way up across epochs; a thousand fakes repay a thousand times the honest judgment labor, and that bill stays linear in identities with no shared shortcut.
